scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.build:api: npm install --workspace=api --include-workspace-root --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild --workspace=api && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.start:api: npm run prisma:deploy --workspace=api && npm run start:prod --workspace=api
